native.summary: Cohesive fundic wall specimen with rugal core, gastric pit-to-branched-gland architecture and layered muscle. Deliberate front stromal window; no geometry labels.
native.scale_note: Local static fundic/body specimen. One unit approximately 0.6 mm vertically; transverse gland caliber, muscle relief, vessel and nerve caliber are selectively enlarged. Cell regions and twelve pit families are teaching samples, not density measurements.

viewer.scale_note: Local static fundic/body specimen. One unit approximately 0.6 mm vertically; transverse gland caliber, muscle relief, vessel and nerve caliber are selectively enlarged. Cell regions and twelve pit families are teaching samples, not density measurements.

teaching_recipe.display_name: Fundic stomach wall: static tissue rebuild
teaching_recipe.summary: Cohesive fundic wall specimen with rugal core, gastric pit-to-branched-gland architecture and layered muscle. Deliberate front stromal window; no geometry labels.
teaching_recipe.scale_note: Local static fundic/body specimen. One unit approximately 0.6 mm vertically; transverse gland caliber, muscle relief, vessel and nerve caliber are selectively enlarged. Cell regions and twelve pit families are teaching samples, not density measurements.

parts.name: Chief-rich gland bases
parts.description: Purple pyramidal/columnar chief-enriched mixed basal cells surround blind-ending gland branches above muscularis mucosae. Chief cells secrete pepsinogen and gastric lipase. Color domains represent regions, not a measured cell census.

parts.name: Circular bundle relief
parts.description: Shallow oriented fascicle relief on its corresponding muscle sheet. Directional teaching convention; not arrows or individual muscle-cell reconstruction.

parts.name: Circular muscle dissection cover
parts.description: Removable anterior teaching window of its named tissue layer. Contiguous with the retained posterior host when visible; hiding it exposes the normally embedded structures without implying a natural cavity.

parts.name: Closed ECL cell representatives
parts.description: Six small closed epithelial cells are embedded basally within representative gland walls with no exocrine-lumen contact. They release histamine toward interstitium; diameter and sample density are schematic. These are complementary fitted cells, not luminal spheres or molecular detail.

parts.name: Fundic gland body epithelium
parts.description: Complementary body lining of long oxyntic gland branches. True lumens are empty and continuous to pits; two/three-branch sampling is schematic, not exact population density.

parts.name: Inner oblique muscle
parts.description: Partial local oblique muscle layer on the submucosal side of circular muscle. Oblique muscle is regionally discontinuous; diagonal ridges are a teaching direction.

parts.name: Lamina propria
parts.description: Connective tissue between fundic glands. Smooth fitted envelopes around enlarged cell samples are a schematic host simplification. The anterior stromal dissection window is deliberate teaching access; removed host is not an anatomical cavity.

parts.name: Longitudinal bundle relief
parts.description: Shallow oriented fascicle relief on its corresponding muscle sheet. Directional teaching convention; not arrows or individual muscle-cell reconstruction.

parts.name: Middle circular muscle
parts.description: Middle circular smooth muscle layer. The local transverse direction is orthogonal to longitudinal bundles; no motion is simulated.

parts.name: Mucous neck epithelial domains
parts.description: Neck epithelial domains include mucous neck cells and renewal region; regional distribution is simplified. Neck is narrower and below the shallow pit.

parts.name: Muscularis mucosae
parts.description: Thin continuous basal mucosal muscle follows the fold above the submucosa. Gland blind ends stay above this boundary.

parts.name: Myenteric connective dissection cover
parts.description: Removable anterior teaching window of its named tissue layer. Contiguous with the retained posterior host when visible; hiding it exposes the normally embedded structures without implying a natural cavity.

parts.name: Myenteric connective tissue plane
parts.description: Thin connective tissue between longitudinal and circular muscle contains the myenteric plexus. Hiding this host exposes neural structures.

parts.name: Myenteric plexus
parts.description: Ganglia and connected neural strands between circular and longitudinal muscle. Neural caliber and ganglia enlarged for visibility; natural host is continuous connective tissue.

parts.name: Oblique bundle relief
parts.description: Shallow oriented fascicle relief on its corresponding muscle sheet. Directional teaching convention; not arrows or individual muscle-cell reconstruction.

parts.name: Outer longitudinal muscle
parts.description: Outer longitudinal smooth muscle sheet. Fine aligned ridges indicate a local direction, not individual myocytes or a whole-organ contraction.

parts.name: Parietal epithelial domains
parts.description: Larger rounded pink secretory cells concentrated in upper and middle gland branches indicate parietal-rich regions. Secrete acid and intrinsic factor; no pumps, canaliculi or molecular channels are modeled.

parts.name: Sectioned epithelial nuclei
parts.description: Representative nuclear profiles within the retained section-plane epithelial wall of the deliberately half-sectioned front-left gland family. Elongated basal chief/columnar profiles and more rounded upper profiles are schematic, with enlarged nuclear dimensions. They are intracellular context, not additional gland lumens.

parts.name: Serosa
parts.description: Thin serosal connective tissue and mesothelial covering on the outer surface. Local wall specimen; omenta are outside scope.

parts.name: Submucosa and rugal core
parts.description: Connective tissue supports the local ruga together with mucosa. Vessels and submucosal plexus are embedded; revealing them by hiding the host does not imply natural empty cavities.

parts.name: Submucosal artery
parts.description: Representative hollow submucosal vessel with open specimen-boundary ends. Caliber exaggerated for recognition; fine capillary/collecting beds and regional extra-wall routes are outside scope.

parts.name: Submucosal dissection cover
parts.description: Removable anterior teaching window of its named tissue layer. Contiguous with the retained posterior host when visible; hiding it exposes the normally embedded structures without implying a natural cavity.

parts.name: Submucosal lymphatic
parts.description: Representative hollow submucosal vessel with open specimen-boundary ends. Caliber exaggerated for recognition; fine capillary/collecting beds and regional extra-wall routes are outside scope.

parts.name: Submucosal plexus
parts.description: Ganglia and connected strands embedded within submucosal rugal core. Neural caliber and ganglia enlarged for visibility; natural host is continuous connective tissue.

parts.name: Submucosal vein
parts.description: Representative hollow submucosal vessel with open specimen-boundary ends. Caliber exaggerated for recognition; fine capillary/collecting beds and regional extra-wall routes are outside scope.

parts.name: Surface and gastric pit epithelium
parts.description: Continuous surface mucous/foveolar lining invaginates into twelve shallow fundic pits, each feeding sampled families of two or three long gland branches. Surface and pit shells are Boolean-united, with no internal occupied seam; neck cells remain distinct. Transverse sampling is enlarged for recognition.
